title: Connect field yield to feedstock quality
lead: The 10 November 2026 brief reads Syngenta's 25 August Yield edition as a data-model lesson for the agriculture-first digital twin. A higher yield is not proof of better fiber feedstock.
summary: Record crop, treatment, yield, moisture, ash, and residue composition together.
description: The 10 November 2026 brief reads Syngenta's 25 August Yield edition as a data-model lesson. Record crop, treatment, yield, moisture, ash, and residue composition together, and do not treat a higher yield as proof of better fiber feedstock.

quote.text: A higher field yield or a biological input is not evidence that residues will be better fiber or process feedstock.
quote.cite: Syngenta The Yield research brief, Rev A · 10 November 2026
